instruction.name: vsubwod.q.du
instruction.description: Subtract the odd-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `b` from the corresponding elements in `a`, extending both to 128-bit, and save the 128-bit result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.
